name: golivebypass-mac
description: Reativa o Go Live do Discord no macOS (Apple Silicon e Intel) com túnel WireGuard só para o Discord.

scripts.build:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html && cp src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/styles.css
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:proton && npm run build:ts && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never
